Container.Name: AMUD-Agent
Container.Overview:
Telemetry sidecar for **AMUD Dashboard**. Polls the Unraid Docker socket and streams host/container metrics to the dashboard over a local Unix socket.
**Install AMUD Dashboard first** (or ensure both are running). The Agent Secret and Socket Path must match the dashboard container exactly.
This container has no web UI. After install, open AMUD Dashboard on port 8000 and check that live telemetry appears within a few seconds.
Docs: https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/docs/installation/unraid
Container.Requires: Requires **AMUD Dashboard** from the same repository with matching Agent Secret and Socket Path.

Config.Name: Agent Socket Dir
Config.Description: Shared directory for the Unix socket. Must match the AMUD Dashboard container exactly.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Read-only Docker socket for container discovery and stats.

Config.Name: Agent Secret
Config.Description: Must be identical to the value on the AMUD Dashboard container.

Config.Name: Docker Monitoring
Config.Description: 1 = enable Docker container telemetry (recommended on Unraid). 0 = host metrics only.

Config.Name: AMUD_SOCKET_PATH
Config.Description: Unix socket path inside the container.

Config.Name: PVE API Token
Config.Description: Optional. Proxmox API token if you also monitor PVE from this agent.
